summary: Iteration_7 Phase 1D verification BLOCKED: external SafeBase backend at https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com is returning HTTP 404 on EVERY /api/* route (POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/health, GET /api/dashboard/widget/score, GET /api/, etc. — all 404). The root domain serves a 200 'Loading...' static page, confirming the FastAPI pod is suspended (same condition documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Because every demo login (trades / hospitality / transport / healthcare / retail) fails with 'Request failed (404)' at the auth step, NONE of the positive Phase 1D flows (create temperature log, create pre-trip, create AHPRA reg, lone-worker check-in, remind, acknowledge, escalate) could be executed end-to-end. What WAS verified despite the backend outage, via direct deep-link navigation on the still-running mobile web preview: (a) all 4 canonical screens MOUNT cleanly with their static chrome — temperature-logs renders the ScreenHeader + 'Record temperature' PrimaryButton + 'Recent logs' Eyebrow; pretrip renders the 19-item checklist (PASS+FAIL toggles count = 19) inside a 6-group accordion; ahpra renders ScreenHeader + 'Add registration'; lone-worker renders ScreenHeader + 'New check-in'. NO red-screen / NO crash on any of the 4 routes. (b) Each screen GRACEFULLY degrades to the friendly error Card ('Request failed (404)') when the backend rejects — exactly the failsafe behaviour the spec required for permission parity, so the 403-style negative path is implicitly proven robust even though the actual 403 code path could not be exercised. (c) Client-side hospitality FSANZ breach prediction works WITHOUT a backend: typing 9°C into fridge surfaced 'Cold storage must be ≤5°C (FSANZ Std 3.2.2)' (test value `hosp_breach: true`). (d) Transport checklist count is 19 NHVR items, not 18 as the spec wording said — Cabin & safety group contains 4 items (seatbelt, mirrors, horn, fire_extinguisher) so 3+3+3+3+3+4 = 19. Worth flagging as a spec/wording mismatch (the screen itself is fine; this is just a count discrepancy between code and the brief). The slim-header / SAFEBASE-wordmark / industry-accent / Iter57 remind+acknowledge assertions could NOT be verified because login is blocked. Recommend the main agent wake the SafeBase backend pod and re-run; the mobile code in the 4 Phase 1D files looks correct on critical-code-review (testIDs in place, error Cards wired to e.detail, useFocusEffect for refresh, KeyboardAvoidingView for inputs).

action_items: WAKE the SafeBase preview backend at https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com (the FastAPI pod / safe-systems project) so /api/auth/login returns 200 again, then re-run Phase 1D verification. Without this, none of the 5 positive flows (hospitality temperature, transport pretrip, healthcare ahpra, retail lone-worker, slim-header parity) and none of the negative-parity (trades user → /hospitality/temperature-logs etc.) checks can be completed.

REVIEW spec vs code: brief says transport pretrip has '18-item NHVR checklist across 6 groups' but /app/frontend/app/transport/pretrip.tsx:43-48 ships 19 items (Cabin & safety contains 4 items: seatbelt, mirrors, horn, fire_extinguisher). Either update the spec to 19, or drop one of those 4 items.

OPTIONAL: When listTemps / listPreTrip / listAhpra / listActive return a 4xx like 404 (not 403), the screens currently say 'Could not load … Your account may not have {industry} enabled.' which is the 403 wording. Consider distinguishing 404 (backend down) from 403 (permission denied) by inspecting status code in api/client.ts and customising the message — improves operator clarity when the SafeBase pod is suspended again.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/hospitality/temperature-logs.tsx:62-69 — client-side FSANZ rule preview (cold ≤5, frozen ≤-15, hot ≥60) mirrors the backend rule and renders an inline 'predict' badge plus a mandatory corrective_action field when breached. Verified the breach branch visually with temp=9°C on a fridge.

/app/frontend/app/transport/pretrip.tsx:17-49 — checklist has 19 items, NOT 18 as the review brief states. The spec wording 'across 6 groups' is correct (Tyres / Lights / Brakes / Load restraint / Fluids / Cabin & safety) but the Cabin & safety group has 4 items, making the total 19. Minor wording fix needed somewhere (spec or code).

/app/frontend/app/healthcare/ahpra.tsx:126-141 — status pill logic ACTIVE / EXPIRING / EXPIRED is computed from _expired || (_days_to_expiry < 0) and _expiring_soon. Correct precedence; expired wins over expiring. Iter57 remind button (ahpra-remind-{reg_id}) calls POST /healthcare/ahpra-register/{reg_id}/remind via HealthcareApi.remindAhpra. Could not exercise live (backend 404) but the wiring matches /app/frontend/src/api/industry.ts:82-83.

/app/frontend/app/retail/lone-worker.tsx:58-87 — acknowledge() defensively handles the documented 404 from /retail/lone-worker/{shift_id}/acknowledge (shift-level vs check-in-level mismatch) and surfaces a 'Heads-up' Alert instead of crashing. Escalate() uses a confirm Alert before POSTing. Good failsafe.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:48-72 — slim header confirmed in source: IndustrySwitcher on the left + notifications bell on the right, NO SAFEBASE wordmark / no ink-coloured header card above. The only SAFEBASE wordmark is on /login (Logo with showWordmark) which is correct (pre-login surface). Could not verify on a logged-in home tab because login is blocked.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/modules.tsx:99-102 — routeFor() correctly maps hospitality/temperature → /hospitality/temperature-logs, transport/pretrip → /transport/pretrip, healthcare/ahpra → /healthcare/ahpra, retail/lone-worker → /retail/lone-worker. Native screen wiring is in place.
/app/frontend/src/theme/colors.ts:34-40 — INDUSTRY_ACCENT trades=#FFA630 ✓, hospitality=#E11D48 ✓, transport=#0DC4B5, healthcare=#2196A6, retail=#A855F7. Matches the brief.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — The external SafeBase FastAPI pod at safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com is suspended / not awake. Symptoms: HTTP 404 on every /api/* route (auth/login, health, dashboard/widget/score, ahpra, temperature-logs, pretrip-inspections, lone-worker/active). Root '/' returns 200 with a static 'Loading...' page (the pod-wake landing). MITIGATION — wake the safe-systems project (POST a request to wake the pod, or restart the FastAPI worker on the SafeBase side) and verify /api/health returns 200 before re-running this iteration's tests. REPRO — curl https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com/api/health → 404 ; curl https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com/ → 200 + 'Loading...'. The mobile app handles this gracefully — every screen shows a 'Request failed (404)' Card instead of crashing — but no positive flow can be tested in this state.
